assessment.nobel_worthiness: Strong, highly distinctive voice. Blinding and Solenoid build dense, visionary prose in which memory, the body and metaphysical speculation form one expansive imaginative system. The ambition of form and the sustained intellectual depth stand out under the common criteria. His poetry background also shapes the linguistic texture of the prose.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation would center on the large-scale visionary novel, with Blinding and Solenoid as the representative works and some credit to the lyric and essayistic strands. The scope is clear and attributable to one writer.
assessment.maturity: A long, sustained career with a coherent, self-renewing project. The major prose works show an oeuvre that has already matured and is likely to endure.
uncertainties: Much of the prose's effect depends on dense Romanian wordplay and rhythm, which translation may flatten.
My knowledge of the poetry and the full body of work is uneven and not independently verified.
Repetition of motifs across large works could be read as either depth or insularity.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Remakes the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red (a verse novel reworking Geryon) and Nox (an elegy built as an object) show formal invention and a distinctive, unmistakable voice. Her intellectual depth and her linguistic precision, shaped by work in the classics and translation, are considerable.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on formal invention across poetry and hybrid prose. Because her genre-crossing is central to the achievement, a framing within Nobel's will would need careful articulation.
assessment.maturity: Decades of consistently inventive work with a recognizable and influential method. The achievement appears mature, though the work varies in register and some pieces are more occasional.
uncertainties: Whether the hybrid and translational work fits the committee's reading of 'literature' and the 'ideal direction' language in the will.
Some effects are bound to the book as a physical object and may not travel in every edition.
The relative weight of her translations versus her original work is unsettled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Grotesque, mythic and allegorical forms expose the violence of ideology and development. The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles show formal daring and moral seriousness. He has also developed a deliberate poetics of the absurd, which he has theorized himself.
assessment.attribution: A citation would center on grotesque and mythic narrative as a vehicle for political and historical experience in Chinese. Political significance must not stand in for literary merit, so the case has to rest on the narrative forms and language.
assessment.maturity: A substantial body of work over several decades, with a developing method. Later works show formal ambition beyond earlier realism.
uncertainties: Translation quality and selection affect how well his linguistic register is conveyed.
The role of censorship and political symbolism in his reception must be separated from the literary assessment.
I may not have an even view across the full corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Remade Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and sustained dialogue with inherited forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and later sequences, together with his critical writing on Arabic poetics, give him formal and linguistic significance that reaches well beyond his own tradition.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on the renewal of modern Arabic poetry as poet and essayist. The two roles are intertwined, which is coherent for a single-writer citation.
assessment.maturity: An oeuvre of many decades with a strong historical influence on poetic practice. Timing is a practical consideration given his age.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation, especially from Arabic, loses much of the formal and prosodic achievement.
My assessment of the range of later work is uneven.
How much of the significance lies in influence on a tradition versus lasting reader reception is hard to separate.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative prose and moral interiority bring theology, family and American history into dialogue. Housekeeping and Gilead show a distinctive, controlled voice and real intellectual depth. Her essays extend the same concerns.
assessment.attribution: A citation would center on contemplative moral fiction, with the essays as a supporting strand. The attribution is clear.
assessment.maturity: The fiction corpus is small but of consistently high quality. Whether its breadth is sufficient for the prize is a judgment call.
uncertainties: The relatively limited number of novels may weigh against the 'sustained' criterion.
The theological framing may limit or complicate the range of the achievement as read within the will.
Differences in how the work is received in translation are not established here.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radically inward fiction that builds distinctive systems of landscape, memory and mental images. The Plains and Border Districts show a rigorous, idiosyncratic voice and formal consistency. The achievement is highly original, with a self-reflexive syntax that is unmistakable.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on an extremely distinctive late-modernist fiction of consciousness and image. The scope is narrow but coherent.
assessment.maturity: Decades of work with a very consistent method, and strong late works. The narrowness of range is a double-edged feature.
uncertainties: The recursive, self-contained project may be judged to lack breadth.
A small readership and limited translation make it hard to judge wider significance.
My knowledge of the later and shorter work is incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed prose that turns obscure lives and art history into powerful narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven show an intensely worked French style and a deep engagement with literary tradition. The language is among the most concentrated on the list.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on a stylistic and historical-imaginative achievement in short, concentrated forms. It is clearly attributable to one writer.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is compact but of consistently high quality. The small volume is a question for 'sustained' achievement.
uncertainties: The small body of work and the difficulty of the style limit the evidence of breadth.
A great deal of the achievement lies in syntax and diction that translation reproduces only partially.
My knowledge of the shorter works is not independently verified.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences and landscape-scale interventions turn suffering into collective memorial form. Purgatory and Anteparadise combine formal audacity with a sustained engagement with history and loss. The scale of the poetic project is unusual.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on a visionary poetry of memory and collective mourning in Spanish. Care is needed to keep the focus on the poems as literature, since the extra-textual interventions and the political context are salient.
assessment.maturity: Decades of continuous work with a coherent project. The oeuvre appears mature, with late work extending earlier motifs.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation, and the visual and landscape works, are hard to assess as literature on the page.
Political and historical symbolism must not substitute for evaluation of the poetry's language.
I have an incomplete view of the later volumes.
